title: Oil Fried Crisp Malaysian Tofu Noodles
description: A plant-based Malaysian dish featuring crispy tofu and noodles in a rich tomato puree sauce, perfect for a post-workout meal.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the tofu cubes to the skillet and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomato puree to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and ginger, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the tomato puree sauce, cooking for 2 minutes.
Return the fried tofu to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce, cooking for 1 minute.
Season the dish with soy sauce to taste, then transfer to a talavera plate to serve.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
